tools.name: browser_context
tools.description: Create a fresh handle for each actual agent before browsing. Signed-in is the default and needs a useful label and an already-attested declared profile. Private is explicit. Keep/resume/discard require the exact returned contextId. Keep across turns without retention approval. Never infer ownership from an MCP connection, PID or title. Unknown cleanup is an error, not disposal.

action.description: Create generates a new contextId for this actual agent. Every other action requires its explicit existing handle; there is no ambient default.

mode.description: Create only. Omit for the declared existing signed-in profile. Choose private explicitly for isolation. Forbidden for other actions.

contextId.description: Required except create, where caller-supplied IDs are forbidden. Retain the exact generated handle, including private- prefix.

label.description: Create only. Required for default/signed-in create; optional for explicit private. Describe the actual agent and useful work, not an ownership principal.

tools.name: browser_command
tools.description: Run an ordinary maintained Playwright CLI page command using this actual agent's explicit contextId. args are argv, never shell text. Use maintained command help/schema. Session/profile/configuration/lifecycle/global overrides are refused. Put literal leading-dash page data after an inner --. Missing sessions are never recreated. Preserve screenshot/export files.

contextId.description: This actual agent's generated handle; mandatory for every command.

args.description: Maintained ordinary page argv, for example ["snapshot"] or ["fill","e4","value"]. No shell or connection options.
